observations.observation: The Decision section names the three Claude Stage A observation identifiers without repeating a member tuple, whereas the adopted D-343 and D-344 Decisions each carried a parenthesised '(members id, observation, whyNotAFinding)'.

Here it is not uniform: OBS-1 and OBS-2 carry raisedAndRefuted and OBS-3 does not, so a single parenthetical in the Decision would have been false. Omitting a tuple is not reciting a wrong tuple, and no member is misattributed anywhere.

verdictStatement: CONSENT. Zero MUST-FIX, zero SHOULD-FIX. Every one of the thirty-three dispatched attacks was run and none survived verification. Fifteen of fifteen cited digests recompute against live bytes; the subject is unmoved at 04575836… and mode 0444; live COORD and live file 08 match the dispatch digests and are unmodified. Both Stage A return shapes are recited without flattening, including the non-uniform Claude observation tuple where OBS-1 and OBS-2 carry raisedAndRefuted and OBS-3 does not, and including the Codex decision object with its five members. Every named identifier exists in the cited reviewer bytes. The v10, v9, and v8 findings land at leftover-join.v11 of sarif because none of those three was ever recorded, and the frozen v5 and v6 landings stay at leftover-join.v7 of sarif. The leftover remasurement the entry records is exactly the delta the candidate's bytes carry against leftover-join.v7 of sarif: OBL-FC-NONAUTH-TERM-FX moves to specified-not-leftover and OBL-FC-OUTFAIL-FX remains leftover-design, which is precisely the measurement D-344 deferred to a later leftover-join remasurement. Required-now stays 28, condition 2 stays 5 of 32, condition 4 stays MET, DR-122 stays PROPOSED-CLOSED-FOR-REVIEW, nothing is SATISFIED or QUALIFIED, no file-08 cell moves, and no implementation is authorized.
